## Summary

## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm verify` is green (format, typecheck, tests, build)
- [ ] Docs updated for user-visible behavior (README / docs/)
- [ ] Tests added or updated for behavior changes
- [ ] Protocol impact assessed: if the wire protocol changed, `docs/protocol` and its version were updated
- [ ] Security impact assessed: if credentials, authentication, or the trust boundary changed, `docs/security` was updated
- [ ] No tokens, credentials, message bodies, or absolute local paths committed
